title: Concrete Vows
description: A raw, percussion-led speed-garage roller at 135 BPM: a swung four-to-the-floor 909 kick, choked shuffled hats and snappy claps under a wobbly sub, with a chopped soul vocal and a sidechained pad floating above. It peaks early then deconstructs into a darker, stripped breakdown before bowing out.
